Targeted Diagnostics

Biology Learning Gaps

Six gaps we see every year in Abu Dhabi biology students.

Memorised Diagrams

Students misread diagrams, lose easy marks interpreting electron micrographs on real papers.

Genetics Traps

Monohybrid crosses feel simple until pedigree charts, sex linkage or codominance appear in exams.

Physiology Gaps

Students learn body systems in isolation and cannot connect them in cross-system exam questions.

Enzyme Graphs

Students misread enzyme graphs when temperature, pH and substrate concentration combine in one question.

Weak Practicals

Students without lab experience lose easy marks on Paper 3 practicals and ATP planning.

IB IA

IB Biology IA marks stall when research questions lack focus or methodology is thin.

Focused Rebuilds

Topics We Rebuild

Our biology tutors close each gap above through focused topic rebuilds.

Cell Biology

Students practise real electron micrographs until identifying organelles under exam conditions becomes second nature.

Inheritance Patterns

Every past-paper style of monohybrid, dihybrid and pedigree drilled until patterns become instantly recognisable.

Human Physiology

Students learn one clear pathway per body system, then connect them across exam questions.

Molecular Biochemistry

Students read enzyme graphs the way mark schemes reward: temperature, pH and substrate compared.

Plant Systems

Photosynthesis, transpiration and osmosis taught early using diagrams the student redraws, not just reads.

Ecology Essays

Essay openings and case studies answer the actual command word, not what students assume.

Admissions Roadmap

The Medicine Pathway

Typical requirements for medicine, dentistry and biomedical courses.

MBRU Dubai

MBRU Dubai expects strong Biology and Chemistry passes with proven English proficiency and an interview.

Khalifa Medicine

Khalifa University expects strong Biology, Chemistry and Physics with high overall grades and an interview.

UK Russell

Russell Group medical schools ask AAA to A*AA including Chemistry and Biology, plus UCAT.

Ireland RCSI

RCSI Ireland requires A-Levels including Chemistry and Biology or an equivalent HL IB grade profile.

Biology TeacherUstaad UAE
How do I draw a monohybrid cross for tall × short pea plants?
00:12 · Solved
Tall (T) is dominant, short (t) is recessive. Cross TT × tt gives all Tt in F1 (100% tall). Cross Tt × Tt in F2 gives TT, Tt, Tt, tt, giving a 3:1 tall to short ratio.

Frequently Asked Questions

Real answers to the biology questions Abu Dhabi parents ask.

Start with the curriculum. Ask any tutor whether they teach Cambridge IGCSE 0610, Edexcel 4BI1, A-Level 9700 or 9BI0, IB HL or SL, or AP Biology. Match on that first, and on district or online delivery second.

Ustaad is a one-to-one biology tutoring service. Group settings can hide specific weaknesses like genetics or physiology gaps for months. In a 1-to-1 session, the tutor spots the gap in the first lesson and rebuilds it directly.

Yes. Most competitive UK medical schools ask for AAA to A*AA including Biology and Chemistry. UAE options like MBRU Dubai and Khalifa University also expect strong science grades. We focus on the topics that carry the highest marks, plus regular past-paper practice.

Yes, both. Ustaad supports IB Diploma Biology at Higher Level and Standard Level, including the syllabus content, the required practicals, and the full Internal Assessment across every criterion.

Rates depend on year group and how many sessions per week. Every family gets a free 30-minute diagnostic lesson first, and a transparent rate quote before any commitment.

Yes for the theory-linked practical skills, which is where most marks sit on Paper 3. Sessions use annotated whiteboards and shared documents, so variable control, error analysis and improvement design are drawn out clearly.

For IGCSE, ideally the start of Year 10. For A-Level and IB, before the second term of Year 12 or DP1. Starting earlier keeps topic gaps from compounding.

Rematching is always free. A better fit usually happens within 48 hours, and lessons pick up from the point the previous tutor reached.
